text: 我的谷歌浏览器用不了了，卸载重装
我来帮你检查一下 Chrome 的情况。

description: Check Chrome installation status
command: which google-chrome 2>/dev/null; dpkg -l | grep -i chrome 2>/dev/null; snap list 2>/dev/null | grep -i chrome
[/external_agent_tool_call]

file: /home/xpqh/.local/bin/google-chrome

Chrome 的安装目录已经不存在了。我来帮你重新下载并安装：

[external_agent_tool_call: Bash]
description: Download Chrome deb package
command: cd /tmp && wget -q https://dl.google.com/linux/direct/google-chrome-stable_current_amd64.deb -O chrome.deb
[/external_agent_tool_call]

[external_agent_tool_result]
Shell cwd was reset to /home/xpqh
[/external_agent_tool_result]

[external_agent_tool_call: Bash]
description: Check downloaded file
command: ls -lh /tmp/chrome.deb
[/external_agent_tool_call]

[external_agent_tool_result]
-rw-rw-r-- 1 xpqh xpqh 135M  8月 28 05:22 /tmp/chrome.deb
[/external_agent_tool_result]

[external_agent_tool_call: Bash]
description: Extract Chrome to user directory
command: mkdir -p /home/xpqh/apps/chrome-extract && cd /home/xpqh/apps/chrome-extract && dpkg-deb -x /tmp/chrome.deb .
[/external_agent_tool_call]

Chrome 已经重新安装好了。让我测试一下能否启动：

[/external_agent_tool_call]
